selection.title: Select Compliance
selection.subtitle: Choose the regulatory standard for your de-identification workflow. The Precision Core engine will automatically calibrate its de-identification heuristics based on your selection.
selection.listSubtitle: Select one or more compliance frameworks to apply

hipaa.label: HIPAA
hipaa.desc: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act. Optimized for US-based clinical data and PHI protection.

gdpr.label: GDPR EU
gdpr.desc: General Data ProtectionRegulation. Rigorous de-identification for EuropeanUnion residency data with strict right-to-erasure support.

ccpa.label: GDPR UK
ccpa.desc: Integrated software development kit for programmatic compliance.Automated enforcement of EUdata sovereignty rules in custom app pipelines.

custom.label: Custom
custom.desc: Create your own compliance profile and configure detection rules for domain-specific workflows.

transformation.title: Transformation
transformation.subtitle: Define the algorithmic parameters for sensitive data scrubbing and PII suppression across clinical documents.

settings.title: De-Identification Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how to handle sensitive information
settings.thresholdHint: Set the minimum confidence threshold (starting from 50%) — only entities above this value will be de-identified.

methodDescriptions.synthetic: Replaces regulated values with realistic synthetic equivalents for safe analysis
